name: SEA – Syddansk Erhvervsakademi
about: SEA is a business academy with campuses in Esbjerg, Sønderborg and Tønder, formerly Erhvervsakademi SydVest (Business Academy SouthWest). Its two English-taught first-year AP degrees are in Esbjerg: Computer Science and Multimedia Design. These combine theory with practical projects and an internship; each is a short-cycle qualification rather than a bachelor's.

languageOfInstruction.note: The two English-taught AP degrees and two top-ups are all in Esbjerg.

notes: Erhvervsakademi SydVest / Business Academy SouthWest is the former name of SEA. Its English first-year AP degrees are in Esbjerg; Sønderborg and Tønder are other institutional campuses.
English B remains a subject requirement on both AP degrees. SEA exempts holders of an International Baccalaureate exam from an English test; whether this includes DP Course Results is not published.

SEA's international-document dates conflict: its FAQ says 1 April, while its full-degree guide says 5 July for EU applicants and 1 May for non-EU applicants. The guide tells applicants receiving their diploma later to contact SEA. Agree the final IB-results arrangement before applying; no separate predicted-grade deadline is published.

EU/EEA/Swiss students pay no tuition; certain Danish residence permits also exempt other students. SEA's linked tariff is labelled 2024/2027: first semester €7,500 including registration, second semester €4,900, year two €8,000, plus €2,000 for Computer Science's fifth semester. Confirm autumn 2027 fees before budgeting.
Full-degree students find their own housing. SEA's offered rooms and housing prices on the international landing page concern Erasmus/exchange students.

SEA sets the offer-acceptance procedure in the individual admission letter in nemStudie; no public 2027 reply date is stated. Arrange the final IB-results delivery method and recipient details with SEA; the IB release date does not establish permission to submit after its document deadline.
